subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ-V8 across its S-Type X200, XJ X308/X350 applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ-V8 spans the S-Type and XJ model lines across naturally aspirated and supercharged variants - a broad range of applications within a single engine family.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, gaskets, and seals as standard on every rebuild, with supercharger components additionally accounted for on AJ27S and AJ33S applications.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: Early AJ-V8 engines (1997-2000) are known for plastic timing chain tensioner failure - the primary guides crack and break off, with pieces ending up in the sump. Cylinder bore problems and Nikasil cylinder lining issues were also present on early engines, resolved by 2002 when later engines used cast-iron linings.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ-V8 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ-V8 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine - illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: Early AJ-V8 engines (1997-2000) are known for plastic timing chain tensioner failure - the primary guides crack and break off, with pieces ending up in the sump. We inspect the timing system thoroughly on every rebuild. Supercharged variants (XJR, S-Type R) require additional specialist attention beyond the naturally aspirated scope.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain, tensioners, guides, bearings, gaskets, plus supercharger components on AJ27S/AJ33S applications

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
